title: Feedback Center
summary: Native bug reporting, suggestions, general feedback and automatic release notes are now part of the BOM Command Deck.

sections.title: Feedback Center
items: Added a member-facing Bug Report system in Discord and the dashboard.
Added member suggestions with support voting, comments and staff triage.
Added private general feedback for staff review.
Added My Reports so members can follow everything they have submitted.

sections.title: Releases & Changelog
items: Added an automated release-manifest system: future update packages can include one JSON release manifest and the bot imports it automatically.
When a changelog Discord channel is configured, new release manifests are posted there once and recorded so restarts do not repost them.
Added a dashboard Releases view with organized changelog sections.

sections.title: Operations
items: Added staff status, severity, priority, visibility and assignment controls.
Added duplicate suggestions and merge support so repeated reports can be consolidated.
Added Discord DM notifications when followed/reported items change status.
Added a dashboard Report a problem shortcut and an error-page shortcut that carries the dashboard error reference into a bug report.
